[
  {

    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.17, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the power conversion efficiency increased from 20.5% to 22.17%"},

    "claims": [
      {"text": "EDC chemical polishing reduced the hysteresis index of devices from 8.27% to 2.44%.", "anchor": "the hysteresis index of EDC‐chemically polished devices decreased from 8.27% to 2.44%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "EDC-modified PSCs retained 83% of initial efficiency after 2000 h under nitrogen atmosphere.", "anchor": "retaining 83% of their initial conversion efficiency after 2000 h of operation under nitrogen atmosphere", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "After 160 h of outdoor aging at 75°C, devices maintained 71.3% of initial efficiency.", "anchor": "After 160 h of outdoor aging at 75°C, these devices maintained 71.3% of their initial efficiency", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.79, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The modified devices, fabricated in air, achieve a champion efficiency of 25.79%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Morpholine-4-carboximidamide hydrochloride enabled air-processed n-i-p PSCs with 25.79% champion efficiency.", "anchor": "The modified devices, fabricated in air, achieve a champion efficiency of 25.79%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retained 95.22% of initial performance after 2400 h in 15–25% relative humidity.", "anchor": "Unencapsulated devices retain 95.22% of their initial performance after 2400 h in 15%–25% relative humidity", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 22.45, "unit": "%", "anchor": "rising from 19.17% to 22.45%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "2PACz molecular diffusion improved PSC efficiency from 19.17% to 22.45%.", "anchor": "the PSCs modified with 2PACz exhibit a notable efficiency enhancement, rising from 19.17% to 22.45%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated 2PACz-modified devices retained 82% of initial efficiency after 2064 h under inert conditions.", "anchor": "the unencapsulated 2PACz‐modified devices retain 82% of their initial efficiency following 2064 h of aging under inert conditions", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.75, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the champion device incorporated with 7‐DCCA achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.75%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "7-DCCA additive improved champion PCE to 23.75% versus control at 21.84%.", "anchor": "the champion device incorporated with 7‐DCCA achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.75%, outperforming the control device (21.84%)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "7-DCCA-treated device maintained 87% of initial efficiency after 480 h at 30–40% RH.", "anchor": "the 7‐DCCA‐treated device still maintained 87% of its initial efficiency after 480 h at 30%–40% relative humidity (RH)", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "module",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.3, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the PSMs achieved PCEs of 23.3% (11.2 cm 2 , aperture area) and 21.2% (694.5 cm 2 , aperture area)"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 694.5, "unit": "cm²", "anchor": "21.2% (694.5 cm 2 , aperture area)"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "In situ dual-stage ATB surface reaction engineering yielded PSMs with 23.3% PCE at 11.2 cm² aperture area.", "anchor": "the PSMs achieved PCEs of 23.3% (11.2 cm 2 , aperture area) and 21.2% (694.5 cm 2 , aperture area)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Modules retained >99% of initial PCE after 2000 h under continuous 1-sun illumination at 25°C.", "anchor": "retaining > 99% of their initial PCE after 2000 h under continuous 1‐sun illumination at 25°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Modules retained >90% PCE following 1600 h at 85°C.", "anchor": "> 90% PCE following 1600 h at 85°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "tin halide perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 13.84, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the power conversion efficiency (PCE) has also risen from 11.04% to 13.84%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "6-Thioguanine increased Voc from 0.80 to 0.92 V in tin perovskite solar cells.", "anchor": "the V oc of the target device with TG has significantly increased from 0.80 to 0.92 V", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PCE of tin PSCs rose from 11.04% to 13.84% with TG additive.", "anchor": "the power conversion efficiency (PCE) has also risen from 11.04% to 13.84%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "TG device maintained approximately 87% of initial PCE after 1400 h in N2 atmosphere.", "anchor": "the TG device can maintain approximately 87% of their initial PCE after being stored in an N 2 atmosphere for 1400 h", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CsPbI3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 17.61, "unit": "%", "anchor": "boosts the efficiency of CsPbI 3 C‐IPSC up to 17.61%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "3MTPACl post-treatment boosted CsPbI3 carbon-electrode PSC efficiency to 17.61%.", "anchor": "which greatly boosts the efficiency of CsPbI 3 C‐IPSC up to 17.61%, accompanied by enhanced humidity, thermal, and long‐term stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": "3D/1D perovskite heterojunction",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.8, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The resulting inverted PSCs achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.8%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "3D/PDAI2/1D heterojunction inverted PSCs achieved 25.8% champion PCE.", "anchor": "The resulting inverted PSCs achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.8%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retained 85% of initial performance after 1000 h of MPPT under 1-sun illumination.", "anchor": "retained 85% of the initial performance after 1000 h of maximum power point tracking under 1-sun illumination", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "CsPbBr3",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 7.78, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The optimized device achieved a 7.78% power conversion efficiency (PCE)"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 64, "unit": "cm²", "anchor": "with an active area of 64 cm 2"},
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "KBDFA interfacial network yielded semi-transparent CsPbBr3 cells with 7.78% PCE and 52.63% average transmittance.", "anchor": "The optimized device achieved a 7.78% power conversion efficiency (PCE) and maintained an average transmittance (AVT) of 52.63%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "A 10 cm × 10 cm module with 64 cm² active area delivered 3.92% PCE.", "anchor": "The corresponding 10 cm × 10 cm module (with an active area of 64 cm 2 ) delivers a respectable PCE of 3.92%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "none",
    "absorber": "Cs0.1(FA0.88MA0.12)Pb(I0.7Br0.3)",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 12.53, "unit": "%", "anchor": "achieves an efficiency of 12.53% under 1,000 lux"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Fully ETL- and HTL-free PSC achieved 12.53% efficiency under 1000 lux indoor illumination.", "anchor": "The fully striped-down structure surprisingly achieves an efficiency of 12.53% under 1,000 lux", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "EMIMAc in the perovskite layer improved energy level alignment, reduced trap density, and enhanced crystallinity.", "anchor": "causing better energy level alignment, reduced trap density, and improved crystallinity", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 23.5, "unit": "%", "anchor": "The PSCs modified with PPZ-TYA achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.5%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PPZ-TYA interface molecules enabled PSCs with 23.5% PCE.", "anchor": "The PSCs modified with PPZ-TYA achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 23.5%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PPZ-TYA devices retained 79.3% of initial efficiency after 1000 h unencapsulated at 25°C and 30–40% RH.", "anchor": "retained 79.3% of the initial efficiency after 1000 h of aging without encapsulation at 25 °C and a relative humidity of 30-40%", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": "perovskite",
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.8, "unit": "%", "anchor": "the resulting perovskite solar cell achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.8%"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "CN-CZ small molecule replacing TBP in spiro-OMeTAD HTL achieved 25.8% PCE.", "anchor": "the resulting perovskite solar cell achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.8%, surpassing that of the TBP-based reference device (23.8%)", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "CN-CZ exhibited stronger Li+ coordination than TBP, enhancing Li-TFSI solubility and HTL film quality.", "anchor": "CN-CZ exhibits stronger Li + coordination, significantly enhancing Li-TFSI solubility in chlorobenzene and improving HTL film quality", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  }
]
